actual_raster_scaling_note: 430px is .681x the631px source body; it is downsampled, not a pixel enlargement. The concern is composition and character-role scale relative to previous appearances.
original_game_role_note: The87.5/350=.25 relationship was provisional in game records, not a physical scale rule for this foreground-video composition.

observations: At430 the bird is visually dominant and close to the panel; the lighthouse door is partly hidden.
At330 the composition is calmer but the bird is still prominent.
At280 the small guide remains clear at480px-wide preview and the lighthouse and coast stay visible.
At240 the small-bird role is natural but the guide is less prominent in a small player.
Source proportions and paper texture are retained across all four sizes. No horizontal or vertical distortion.

alpha_noise_assessment: Source has very low-alpha background speckles outside the alpha>=8 body. At resized output they are at most the maxima recorded here; consider using the project original alpha-discard policy in compositing, without modifying the source PNG. No visible opaque halo was seen.
motion_recommendations: Use the same thin neutral image for one or two small fixed-x hops; a short vertical trajectory and scaled shadow keep stroke and identity stable.
Place any gesture after a teaching line, away from number transitions; vary timing and do not hop on every count.
Existing reaction atlases have heavier contours. Do not use a large-version bold pose or a position-only nod as if it were a ground peck.
A smooth flap or actual peck needs matched poses before it can be adopted; no such motion is claimed as already implemented.
comparison_shadow_note: Diagnostic previews scale the shadow with actor height, correcting the renderer current fixed shadow for the comparison.
